items.title: Election Day Announcement Megaphone
items.alt: A cream-and-navy megaphone stands beside an Election Day placard and small gold stars.
items.description: The burgundy hand grip angles beneath the wide horn, with a navy strap curling onto the surface beside it. A double-lined border frames the compact cream sign and its two-word message.

items.title: Community Voter Information Kiosk
items.alt: A silver-haired volunteer stands beside a navy-and-cream kiosk marked Voter Info.
items.description: The woman in a mustard jumpsuit rests one hand beside a small blank tablet on the counter. Clear pamphlet holders stand at either end beneath the tall navy header and its simple cream lettering.

items.title: Equipment Practice at a Workbench
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows an instructor demonstrating a tablet cable beside a control panel while a young adult watches.
items.description: The apron-wearing woman holds the small screen above the complete workbench as the hooded learner leans toward the controls. A closed equipment case and coiled lead provide additional practice props without a named device model.

items.title: Hanging an Election Day Banner
items.alt: Two volunteers hang an Election Day fabric banner between freestanding posts in black-and-white line art.
items.description: One person stands on a small folding stool to secure the right-hand rope while the other holds the opposite corner. The outlined cloth droops naturally between the posts above their wide braced bases.

items.title: Reading a Large-Print Sample Sheet
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows an older woman using a magnifier to read a large Sample sheet at an adjustable desk.
items.description: Round glasses and a patterned cardigan frame the woman's focused expression above the empty oval rows. The desk's broad crossbar and T-shaped feet remain visible beside her wheeled chair and shoes.

items.title: A Question at a Community Forum
items.alt: Black-and-white line art shows three seated adults and a standing facilitator beside a Community Forum sign.
items.description: A man in a checked shirt raises his hand while a headscarf-wearing woman and a long-haired man listen from separate chairs. The facilitator holds a clipboard beneath the large two-line sign.
